setup: Require absent target and isolated GUID staging; transfer only the verified archive and manifest with noninteractive SSH/SCP
execution: Hash-check transfer, use the unchanged Linux publisher in isolated staging, move only the new version into downloads, atomically replace the index after retaining its previous contents
verification: Fetch the public manifest and archive, verify SHA256 and latest-client links, compare previous version and signed updater hashes before and after
cleanup: Always remove owned remote staging and local verification download; retain result and index rollback snapshot
rollback: Restore the retained previous index and withdraw only the owned new 0.14.21 directory if publication fails; never change older versions or updater manifests
acceptance_limit: Download publication only; authenticated Character-to-world runtime evidence remains pending
